summary: Frontend-only verification of TU calendar + Kiosk TV timezone bug fix (ymd() using local date parts). Playwright launched with timezone_id='Asia/Jakarta' (UTC+7) to reproduce the original off-by-one bug environment. Used pre-existing approved booking LAB-2026-0048 (2026-07-02, Labor 1, 09:00-11:00, disetujui). Kiosk token regenerated for /kiosk/tv access. All primary and regression checks passed.
passed: TU /dasbor/tu (admin) navigated to Juli 2026 — cell data-testid='day-2026-07-02' contains chip '09:00 L1'
TU cell data-testid='day-2026-07-03' does NOT contain the 09:00 booking (shows only unrelated 08:00 L1 booking)
TU day-detail-list on click of July 2 shows LAB-2026-0048, DISETUJUI, Labor 1, 09:00–11:00 (regression: correct date/booking retained)
Kiosk TV /kiosk/tv?token=... navigated to Juli 2026 — July 2 cell shows '09:00 Labor 1', July 3 cell shows '08:00 Labor 1' (no shift)
Kiosk 'HARI INI · 2026-07-01' section renders today's date correctly under Asia/Jakarta timezone
Month header renders 'Juli 2026' and prev/next navigation works on both pages
notes: Bug fix verified — bookings no longer render one column to the right in positive-UTC-offset timezones. Same behavior confirmed on TataUsahaDashboard and KioskTV since both share the same local-date ymd() helper.
